task.title: Add a role to a group
task.shortdesc: Add a role to an existing group to provide additional permissions to all members of that group. You can view user details to add roles to a group that the user belongs to.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

prereq.note: You can add a role to a group from the Users page, or by editing a group from the Groups page. These steps show you how to edit the group from the user details page.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > UsersRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Users to open the Users list.
Click the Username for a user to open the user details page.
Click the count in the Groups column for a role. This shows the groups the user is a member of that have this role assigned.

info.note: You can view the permissions a role provides by clicking the count in the Permissions column.

step.cmd: Click Add role to this group next to the group name to add additional role(s) to the group. This opens the Add roles dialog.
Select the checkbox for each role(s) you want to add to the group. (Only roles not yet associated with the group are listed.) Click Add to group.
Reload the user details page to see the roles you added to the group.

info.p: The group now has these additional permissions in the console.
